snippet.title: RD Racing Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the Early Access version of RD RACING.

High-speed combat. Ruthless rivals. No rules.

Race through intense tracks, destroy your enemies, earn cash, and upgrade your machine into the ultimate road weapon. This is just the beginning — more cars, more weapons, more chaos are coming soon.

Music by: Bensound.com/royalty-free-music
License code: 3GKAFOIOT3QPXV7A
Artist: : Benjamin Tissot
